name: c-alert-dialog-1
title: Basic alert dialog with title, description, and action buttons
label: Basic
description: Basic alert dialog with title, description, and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: A plain text confirmation with centered title and copy above Cancel and Continue

whenNotToUse.when: An irreversible delete that calls for a red destructive button

name: c-alert-dialog-2
title: Small size alert dialog for quick confirmations
label: Small Size
description: Small size alert dialog for quick confirmations

guidance.bestFor: A compact permission prompt in the small size, its 2 buttons sharing the footer width
A default size prompt with an icon tile above the title, here pairing a Bluetooth device

name: c-alert-dialog-4
title: Small size alert dialog with media (icon)
label: Small With Icon
description: Small size alert dialog with media (icon)

guidance.bestFor: The small size with an icon tile, for a quick yes or no question about an accessory

name: c-alert-dialog-5
title: Destructive alert dialog for irreversible actions like deletion
label: Destructive Delete
description: Destructive alert dialog for irreversible actions like deletion

guidance.bestFor: An irreversible delete with a red trash icon, a destructive button and a link in the copy

name: c-alert-dialog-6
title: Alert dialog nested within a standard Dialog component
label: Nested In Dialog
description: Alert dialog nested within a standard Dialog component

guidance.bestFor: A confirmation launched from a button inside an open Dialog, stacked above it
A success notice with a green check and a do not show again checkbox beside the buttons
agentNotes: The `show-again` `Checkbox` is uncontrolled and stored nowhere; save its value before the dialog closes

whenNotToUse.when: A success message that needs no decision from the user

guidance.bestFor: An account deactivation warning with the icon left of the title and a destructive confirm

name: c-alert-dialog-9
title: Warning for unsaved changes when navigating away
label: Unsaved Changes
description: Warning for unsaved changes when navigating away

guidance.bestFor: An unsaved changes guard inside a Frame panel, with Stay, Discard and a do not ask again box
agentNotes: Nothing here detects unsaved edits; open it from your navigation guard rather than the `AlertDialogTrigger` button

guidance.bestFor: A booking receipt listing 5 order fields above one full width Back to Home button
agentNotes: The only button is `AlertDialogCancel` styled as primary, so Back to Home just closes the dialog

name: c-alert-dialog-11
title: System update notification requiring application restart
label: System Update
description: System update notification requiring application restart

guidance.bestFor: An update prompt with a release version badge and a tinted lower band holding copy and buttons

name: c-alert-dialog-12
title: Billing warning for expired subscriptions or failed payments
label: Billing Warning
description: Billing warning for expired subscriptions or failed payments

guidance.bestFor: A plan expiry warning with a red bell, an expires in 2 days badge and an Update Payment action
A sign out check whose No and Yes buttons split the footer into 2 flush cells with a divider
A summary of 3 security checks with Pending or Done badges above stacked full width buttons
agentNotes: Replace `SECURITY_ITEMS` with your checks; any `status` other than Pending renders the success badge
